turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
How did that feel for you?
I phoned my mother and told her about the eating disorder service, and she said she loves me.
Mm-hm. Go on.
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. It is not easy to talk about.
How did that feel for you?
I walked past the dance studio and felt a sharp longing to go back.
Take your time.
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I keep coming back to it.
Take your time.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
How did that feel for you?
I got a sixty-eight percent on the property law exam, which is a two-one, and I did not fall apart.
Take your time.
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. That is how it was.
What happened next?
I ate a bowl of porridge every morning this week, which feels terrifying.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. That is how it was.
Mm-hm. Go on.
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
